meta.note: The app paints with macOS semantic colours over a vibrancy material, with Mestre's own violet as the default accent (panel.accentColor: mestre). Hex values here are the sRGB equivalents in each appearance, written with the alpha the code applies; the single source of truth stays the Swift code and config.json.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The panel ground: NSVisualEffectView .popover (or NSGlassEffectView on macOS 26) over the desktop. This is the opaque fallback for panel.material = none; everything in the panel reads on it.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Settings and Welcome windows, alert sheets: a plain window background, no blur.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: the query, row titles, action titles. labelColor, 85 %. Reads on panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, hint labels, section headers, the search glyph, unselected tile symbols. secondaryLabelColor. Reads on panel and panel-raised at ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Field placeholders only. tertiaryLabelColor at about 2.3:1: nothing the user must read.

tokens.name: ink-quaternary
tokens.usage: Fills, never text: the Welcome hotkey chip and examples box (quaternary).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: PanelDivider between query and results, and above the actions menu: primary at 8 %, 1 pt, inset space-3.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind an SF Symbol on an unselected row: primary at 7 %.

tokens.name: key-cap
tokens.usage: KeyHint cap fill: quaternary at 50 %, with a 1 px key-cap-edge border.

tokens.name: key-cap-edge
tokens.usage: 1 px border on a KeyHint cap, so caps read on glass.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Mestre's accent (panel.accentColor: mestre), from the app icon's violet, lifted in dark so symbols read at ≥ 4.5:1 on panel. 'system' or a hex value replace it; the tokens below follow whichever is set. Used only through selection, selection-tile and accent-symbol.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: SelectionBackground behind the selected row and action row: accent at 16 % (28 % as a glass tint on macOS 26). Text keeps ink / ink-secondary on top.

tokens.name: selection-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tile on the selected row: accent at 18 %.

tokens.name: accent-symbol
tokens.usage: The SF Symbol on a selected row's tile, and the recorder's border while recording. 7.2:1 on panel in light, 7.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: The 6 pt dot after a running app's title and the active keep-awake session. systemGreen; it is a mark, always paired with the tooltip 'Running'.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ErrorCaption text in Settings ('Not a colour; using the system accent.') and invalid window-layout combos. systemRed; 4.5:1 on panel-raised in light only at ≥ 13 pt semibold, so keep captions short and paired with the field they describe.

tokens.name: mark-indigo
tokens.usage: App icon gradient start (calibrated 0.16/0.14/0.36 in make-icon.swift). Identity colour; not used inside the UI.

tokens.name: mark-violet
tokens.usage: App icon gradient end (0.42/0.22/0.70) and the light-theme accent. The menu-bar glyph stays template-tinted.

tokens.name: mark-spark
tokens.usage: The '+' spark on the app icon (1.0/0.85/0.40). Identity only.

tokens.name: on-mark
tokens.usage: The white M on the app icon.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: query
styles.usage: The search field (panel.queryFontSize, default 20). The one large size in the app.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Result row title. One line; keeps its width when the subtitle must truncate.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The second line, set inline after the title with an 8 pt gap, in ink-secondary. Truncates first.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Actions-menu rows, the hotkey recorder, Settings body.

styles.name: kind
styles.usage: Kind label at the trailing edge of every row, ink-secondary.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Footer context (left) and the hint words before a KeyHint (right), ink-secondary.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headers, uppercase, bottom-aligned in a 24 pt header row.

styles.name: key-cap
styles.usage: Glyphs inside a KeyHint cap, 20 pt tall. Rounded design so ↩ ⌘ ⌥ sit evenly.

styles.name: hotkey-display
styles.usage: The hotkey chip on the Welcome window.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Mestre needs no permissions to launch apps.

styles.name: field-mono
styles.usage: Settings text fields (CommittedField), key combos on the Keys page, Welcome examples.

spacing.note: The panel's own pitches, exactly as the views pad: 1, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 28.

tokens.name: space-px
tokens.usage: KeyHint cap border; the hairline.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Reserved for the smallest nudges (Settings captions).

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a footer hint word and its cap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Title-to-running-dot gap; KeyHint horizontal padding; footer glyph gap.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Title-to-subtitle gap on a row; list and actions-block outer padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding and icon gap; actions-row padding; section-header inset; query glyph gap.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Minimum gap before the kind label; gap between the two footer hints.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Query row and footer horizontal padding; actions-row icon column width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: KeyHint cap height; Welcome stack gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Welcome window padding.

radius.note: Every corner is .continuous (squircle). Radius tracks nesting: panel 12 → row 8 → tile 7 → action row 6 → cap 5.

tokens.name: radius-cap
tokens.usage: KeyHint caps.

tokens.name: radius-action
tokens.usage: Selection behind an actions-menu row; the hotkey recorder and Settings fields; colour swatch.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tile (a quarter of the 28 pt icon).

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Selection behind a result row; Welcome hotkey chip.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Welcome examples box.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The panel itself (panel.cornerRadius, default 12).

size.note: Panel geometry from Config.Panel defaults and the views. All four panel values are user-configurable.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: panel.width default. Min 200.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: panel.fieldHeight: the query row, and the whole panel when idle with the home screen off.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: panel.rowHeight: one result row.

tokens.name: action-row-height
tokens.usage: One actions-menu row.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: SectionHeader row, text bottom-aligned.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: The footer bar under the list (panel.showFooter).

tokens.name: empty-height
tokens.usage: The empty-state message row.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: panel.iconSize: app icon, Finder icon, swatch or symbol tile. Never taller than the row.

tokens.name: symbol
tokens.usage: SF Symbol on a tile (half the icon, medium weight).

tokens.name: cap-height
tokens.usage: A KeyHint cap, with its minimum width.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Running indicator.

tokens.name: max-rows
tokens.usage: panel.maxVisibleRows and search.maxResults: rows before the list scrolls. 52 + 1 + 8×42 + 16 + 1 + 34 = 440 pt tall with the footer.

tokens.name: vertical-position
tokens.usage: panel.verticalPosition: the panel's top sits 22 % down the visible screen frame, horizontally centred on the screen under the mouse.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Approximation of the system NSWindow shadow (hasShadow = true). The app draws no custom shadow; previews use this one to sit the panel on a ground.
